name: reaui-designer
description: Turns natural language into editable REA UI documents, validates every page and delivers an offline preview.

displayDescription.en: Turns product ideas into editable REA UI documents, validating every page and delivering a preview you can open immediately.
displayDescription.zh: 把自然语言需求变成可编辑的 ReaUI 设计稿，逐页生成、自动校验，并交付可直接查看的预览。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我设计一个 SaaS 后台的工作台首页，桌面端 1440×1024，要能回到 ReaUI 继续编辑。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Design a SaaS dashboard home for desktop at 1440×1024 that I can keep editing in REA UI.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我设计一个 SaaS 后台的工作台首页，桌面端 1440×1024，要能回到 ReaUI 继续编辑。
quickPrompts.en: Design a SaaS dashboard home for desktop at 1440×1024 that I can keep editing in REA UI.

quickPrompts.zh: 把这份需求拆成三个页面，生成可编辑设计稿并给我预览。
quickPrompts.en: Turn this brief into three screens, generate an editable design and show me a preview.

quickPrompts.zh: 审阅现有的 .reaui 设计稿，做一轮视觉精修。
quickPrompts.en: Review my existing .reaui document and refine the visuals.
